_comment: Doc 03 §2.9 / §3.4 — THE difficulty file. One file, one schema, one loader (report 98 C-17, closed as doc 91 A91-D-19). Every difficulty scalar in the project lives here; a knob authored anywhere else is a load error in the file that carries it. Doc 03 owns the file and the schema; the four sections are authored by the docs named in meta.sections. Read ONLY through sim/economy/difficulty.gd — no system opens this file.
_rules: 1. meta.presets is exactly casual/standard/hard/crisis, in that order, and every section carries a row for all four — a missing preset is a load error, never a silent default. 2. Values are scalars (int/float/bool) only; a knob that needs a table belongs in the owning system's own data file, gated by a scalar here. 3. Every knob named M_* or ending _mult/_fraction must declare a direction in its section's _direction map and must be strictly monotone casual->crisis in that direction (doc 03 §3.4 rule 4). 4. Underscore-prefixed keys are notes, never knobs.

economic._note: Doc 03 §2.9's authored table, verbatim. starting_treasury is the founding balance; OFF_TAU_HOURS is §2.11's taper constant and MOVED here out of data/economy.json.offline (rule 2 — it is a difficulty scalar).

pressure._note: Doc 07 §8.3's four knobs plus soft_suppression, MOVED here out of data/director.json._difficulty_fallback (C-17). repair_cost_mult is DELETED — repair difficulty is economic.M_repair and nothing else. soft_suppression carries no direction: it is a bool, not a scale, and F5's earned suppression is simply absent on crisis.

escalation._note: Doc 06 §8's two knobs, MOVED here out of data/incidents.json.difficulty_escalation (C-17). OFFLINE_RESPONSE_TIME_MULT was seeded by doc 03 §2.12 and files here with its owner; it is a SEAM today — doc 06's offline auto-response path does not read it yet, and the row exists so that path has one number to read when it lands, not four scattered ones.

offline._note: Doc 08 §2.3's one knob, authored at §12 and never filed anywhere (data/persistence.json never carried it — C-17 moved it here before it shipped). A SEAM today, on the same terms as OFFLINE_RESPONSE_TIME_MULT above.
